nodes.label: NGC CUDA 13.2.1 Runtime Base Image
nodes.rationale: Uses nvcr.io/nvidia/cuda:13.2.1-runtime-ubuntu24.04 matching JetPack 7.2 / Ubuntu 24.04 so host-compiled aarch64 binaries run inside a lean runtime image instead of a large devel image.

nodes.label: Runtime System Libraries (libcurl4, libgomp1)
nodes.rationale: Installs only libcurl4 (URL model downloads) and libgomp1 (OpenMP used by both llama.cpp and sd.cpp) without compiling inference engines inside Docker.

nodes.label: Shared Docker Runtime Image
nodes.rationale: Single Dockerfile reused by both qwen38-27b and qwen-image services; contains no compiled inference engines and no model weights.

nodes.label: x-llama-common Compose Anchor
nodes.rationale: Defines shared runtime, GPU CDI, host networking, memlock ulimit, model volume, and /opt/llama read-only mounts for llama.cpp containers.

nodes.label: x-sd-common Compose Anchor
nodes.rationale: Mirrors x-llama-common GPU/network/UMA/volume settings while mounting /opt/sdcpp/bin:ro instead of /opt/llama to isolate stable-diffusion.cpp's forked ggml.

nodes.label: qwen38-27b LLM Service Container (port 8085)
nodes.rationale: Runs llama-server on Qwen3.8-27B GGUF with MTP speculative decoding, 256K context, FlashAttention (q8_0/q4_0 KV cache), and mlock.

nodes.label: qwen-image Service Container (port 8083)
nodes.rationale: Runs sd-server on Qwen-Image-2.1 (GGUF diffusion model, bf16 safetensors VAE, Qwen3-VL-8B encoder, mmproj) with --sage-attn.

nodes.label: Host /usr/local -> /opt/llama:ro Mount
nodes.rationale: Mounts host /usr/local/bin and /usr/local/lib to non-standard /opt/llama/*:ro so nvidia-cdi-hook cudacompat does not scan libggml-cuda.so ELF headers and panic.

nodes.label: Host /opt/sdcpp/bin -> /opt/sdcpp/bin:ro Mount
nodes.rationale: Mounts statically-linked sd-server binary from isolated /opt/sdcpp/bin prefix so sd.cpp's forked ggml does not overwrite llama.cpp shared libraries in /usr/local/lib.

nodes.label: Shared Model Volume (/mnt/ssd/huggingface -> /root/.cache/huggingface)
nodes.rationale: Keeps multi-gigabyte GGUF, MTP, safetensors VAE, and mmproj weights outside Docker images on host SSD and shares them across both service containers.

nodes.label: NVIDIA Runtime & CDI GPU Injection (nvidia.com/gpu=all)
nodes.rationale: Uses runtime: nvidia, devices: nvidia.com/gpu=all, NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all, and NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all to expose Jetson Orin GPU and host Tegra driver libraries.

nodes.label: Manual LD_LIBRARY_PATH (nvgpu, no openrm)
nodes.rationale: Required because nvidia-ctk update-ldcache hook is disabled on JetPack 7.2; qwen38-27b prepends /opt/llama/lib while qwen-image uses only Tegra nvgpu paths (excluding openrm).

nodes.label: Jetson UMA Unified Memory (GGML_CUDA_ENABLE_UNIFIED_MEMORY=1)
nodes.rationale: Enables cudaMallocManaged and system-memory-based VRAM budget calculation on Jetson 64GB unified memory architecture.

nodes.label: Host Network Mode (network_mode: host)
nodes.rationale: Eliminates Docker port mapping so qwen38-27b (8085) and qwen-image (8083) bind directly on host interfaces.

nodes.label: Unlimited Memlock ulimit (soft/hard: -1)
nodes.rationale: Prevents 'failed to mlock ... Cannot allocate memory' when llama-server runs with --load-mode mlock.

nodes.label: README Section 0 & Section 5 Docker Architecture Docs
nodes.rationale: Documents two-stage build vs up lifecycle, host-to-container mount mapping, and JetPack 7.2 CDI workaround.
nodes.norm_label: readme section 0 & section 5 docker architecture docs

nodes.label: Host-Compiled llama.cpp Engine (/usr/local)
nodes.rationale: Compiled on host with sm_87, GGML_CUDA_NO_VMM=ON, GGML_CUDA_FA_QUANTS=all, GGML_CUDA_GRAPHS=ON, CCCL v3.4.3; installed to /usr/local.

nodes.label: Host-Compiled stable-diffusion.cpp Engine (/opt/sdcpp)
nodes.rationale: Compiled on host with sm_87 and GGML_CUDA_NO_VMM=ON; statically links forked ggml while dynamically linking CUDA runtime/libgomp1/driver libs.

nodes.label: JetPack 7.2 NVIDIA Container Toolkit CDI Workaround
nodes.rationale: Sets mode='cdi' in config.toml and disables enable-cuda-compat,update-ldcache hooks in nvidia-cdi-refresh.env to prevent toolkit 1.19.1 slice bounds panic.
nodes.norm_label: jetpack 7.2 nvidia container toolkit cdi workaround

nodes.label: qwen-image APIs (/v1, /sdapi/v1, /sdcpp/v1)
nodes.rationale: Documents OpenAI generation endpoint (/v1/images/generations) and native async edit endpoint (/sdcpp/v1/img_gen with ref_images, avoiding /v1/images/edits).
